title: Etched doubled to $21B in a month
angle: The capital is moving from models to the hardware that serves them.

frames.text: A chip company just doubled its valuation in under a month.
Raised this week, led by the trading firm Jane Street.
Up from $10.3B in July. Doubled in under a month.
Over $1B in orders already booked, and the chips are shipping.
Full systems for running AI models. Not for training them.
Everyone watches which model wins. The money moved to inference.
